learning_outcomes.text: Understanding methodologies and technologies for designing and implementing mobile applications (apps).
Main platforms oriented to app development and distributed software architectures.
Design and build applications for mobile devices using popular cross-platform frameworks.

assessment_methods.method: Group Project Work (design and realization of a mobile application)

assessment_rules: The final test verifies knowledge, understanding, and application ability. Students will be assigned a group project work. The exam will consist of a discussion of the project and an oral interview on the course contents. In the final vote, the project evaluation will weigh 60% and the oral interview 40%.
